contract: POST /api/share/mediaitem. Admin creates a media-item share with validated slug/media identity/download/expiry settings, persisted compatible timestamps and share_open event; invalid or conflicting input denies.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.

invariants.contract: POST /api/share/mediaitem is admin-only (401 unauthenticated, 403 non-admin). It requires a non-blank string slug, mediaItemType 'book' or 'podcastEpisode', a string mediaItemId and a non-negative numeric expiresAt (0 stores NULL), rejects an unknown media item with 404 and an already used slug or mediaItemId with 409 before writing anything, and on success answers 201 with id, mediaItemId, mediaItemType, slug, expiresAt (ISO string or null), createdAt/updatedAt (equal, the request time) and isDownloadable. Exactly one mediaItemShares row owned by the caller is persisted with NULL pash/extraData and the returned slug immediately serves the public consumer routes; the admin item detail with expanded=1&include=share exposes the same client share, while a non-admin detail does not. A positive expiresAt already in the past is accepted with 201 and a share_open but is immediately unscheduled, its row removed and the slug never opened.
exceptions: A rejected create leaves the mediaItemShares row count and every existing row unchanged and emits no share_open to an admin or listener socket.
An omitted isDownloadable is persisted as NULL and returned as null; the web ShareModal always sends a boolean.
